MEASURED from Alpaca docs (docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/paper-trading, updated 2026-07-07): there is no in-place reset any more. The dashboard OPENS A NEW paper account (new account number, new API keys required, balance chosen at creation, default $100k) and can DELETE the old one. No Trading-API endpoint for it is documented. So the reset works like this: the operator creates the new paper account and its keys, then pastes them into the two EXISTING Actions secrets ALPACA_API_KEY_ID / ALPACA_API_SECRET_KEY (alpaca_paper's default pair, which is also the equity market-data pair).
